title: ON.energy split testimonial
description: A light band split in two: a big weight-300 heading on the left whose letters blur in as it scrolls into view, and in the right half a light quote in soft grey quotation marks, the customer's bold wordmark, name and role, and a black button. Two small dark arrow tiles with dotted arrows step through the quotes, each fading in.
notes: inverted on purpose: bg-foreground with text-background, so it is light on the dark theme and dark on the light one
needs JavaScript for the arrows (hydrate: visible); static HTML shows the first quote
